mcts.seed: same fixed seed and saved starting RNG as prior fixtures

new_method: Execution-compatible subtree plus recorded sample suffixes, one native-random tail transition for nonterminal suffixes, rebuild visit/value sums before fresh iterations.
design_origin: New project adaptation; not a verbatim paper replication or a theoretical equivalence theorem.
promotion_guards: full immutable state and codec equal

return_semantics.root: sum gamma^k * r[k], k=0..H-1 or earlier absorbing terminal
return_semantics.nonroot: includes incoming edge reward, matching native backup convention
return_semantics.horizon_correction: drop old r0, retain old suffix, append one native rollout transition unless absorbing terminal; never substitute zero for a missing nonterminal tail
return_semantics.old_Q_policy: old value sums and visit counts zeroed and recomputed from corrected sample records; no direct old Q copying
return_semantics.budget: m inherited corrected sample contributions + (64-m) NEW tree iterations =64 root contributions; inherited samples are historical/adaptive, not new independent observations
return_semantics.root_edge_note: promoted root may include a root-only prior rollout; root child counts can sum to63 while root count64; explicitly record rather than force fake visits

changed_behavior: Cold first search must equal native. Reused second action, RNG, visits, and Q may legitimately differ; each returned action still passes native feasibility checks.
uncertainty: Retained rollouts reflect the old adaptive policy; horizon correction aligns return length, not unbiasedness, optimal Q, safety, or general improvement.
guards_failure: Exact state/config/domain mismatch falls back to a fresh native-semantic root at unchanged budget; corrupt/missing sample evidence raises HOLD without silent fabricated values.
pass: Eight searches completed, first-call exact parity, two guarded promotions on unchanged fixtures, independent full-reward/statistics reconstruction, fixed H8; safety negatives or fallback-only separately classified
timing: Full system.search includes trace capture, identity checks, suffix tail calls, retained-statistic rebuilding and in-search snapshot overhead; full debug export, IO, init and outer propagation excluded. Report totals for both calls. Technical two-pair smoke not a stable speed benchmark.
fixed_stop: At most2 fixtures x2 decisions x2 arms. True terminal stops local sequence; never change seeds or rerun to reach8. Preserve failure/negative results.
